messages:
marie: Heads up — found partner service-account creds inside daily S3 backup object. It is KMS-wrapped but treat as potential exfil. :rotating_light:

 tim: path and scope?

 marie: s3://redwood-backups/partner-accts/2026-03-22/snap.tar.gz
 marie: looks like a single object for partner-x, quick glance shows a file named "partner-prod-sa.json" inside

 vault-bot: detection: S3 object flagged by secret-detector v2.3; sha256=abc123def456; match type=google-service-account keyfile

 olga: recommend immediate containment: RBAC freeze for that partner SA, rotate keys, and rewrap KMS ciphertexts for backups. Preserve audit logs (do not delete).

 marie: +1. Need someone to lead rotation + KMS rewrap. Infra has a maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC — would prefer to perform rewrap inside it.

 dan: I can lead the rotation. Will coordinate with infra oncall. Proposed order: 1) revoke current keys, 2) create new SA key, 3) re-encrypt backups, 4) update partner config and verify.

 tim: add step 0: snapshot current IAM bindings and export audit logs before any change. Quick commands: 
 ```
 # export iam bindings
 gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod > iam-binding-20260322.json
 # export cloud audit logs for window
 gcloud logging read 'resource.type=project AND timestamp>"2026-03-22T00:00:00Z"' --limit=1000 > audit-window.log
 ```

 olga: also capture KMS key metadata and current key version/wrapping info: 
 ```
 aws kms list-keys --profile infra
 aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/backup-key
 ```

 marie: also create a deny IAM rule to block service-account key creation for the partner until we confirm cleanup.

 oncall-desk: infra team paged; oncall @mike notified and looking at schedule.

 mike: seen. I'll reserve 02:15-02:45 UTC for the rewrap work. Dan/Olga please confirm the runbook by EOD so we can sync pager.

 dan: drafting runbook now. Early checklist: 
 - revoke partner-prod-sa.json from IAM
 - create new SA and generate key
 - rotate partner config to new key (coordinate deployment)
 - re-encrypt archived blobs using rewrap script (see below)
 - run verification job to ensure no residual plaintext in backups or caches

 marie: ensure provable audit trail: copy object metadata + sha256 to secure bucket s3://redwood-incident-audit/6087654321/ before rewrap. Do not delete original until after verification.

 vault-bot: incident created ID INC-6087654321. Audit logging enabled; retention set to 365d. Notifying security incident channel.

 olga: minor note — invalidate any downstream caches that might hold the old SA creds (API token caches, ephemeral deployment caches). Add cache invalidation step to runbook.

 marie: good call. Dan, can you own post-rotation validation (test deploy + smoke tests + partner verification)?

 dan: yes. I'll run smoke tests and post results here. Starting runbook PR now and will assign to @olga for review.

 marie: thanks. I'll loop in legal and partner-ops for notification and next steps. :white_check_mark:

 mike: oncall will standby during rewrap window and can support rollbacks if needed.

 marie: keeping this thread as primary status log — please post short updates only (status, ETA, blockers).

 dan: update: runbook PR opened at https://phabricator.redwood/PR/789 — assigning to @olga. Estimated rotation start 02:20 UTC.

 marie: acknowledged. tagging partner-ops to expect brief outage for config swap.

 legal: noted, we will prepare notification template; do not send external comms until partner-ops approves.

 marie: final note — if we find any unwrapped/plaintext artifacts during verification, escalate to incident SEV-1 and preserve all images/logs.

 dan: will do. Posting status updates as we progress.
